rules: P-authored ordinary one-usize-formal known-direct pure u8 selection, two normal arms, real source arguments. Source definition CHECK sees unknown formal; no host seed supplies runtime authority.
== and < compare numeric values only; preserve true Bool Unknown without pretending either operand is known or conflating equal bits with package/world identity.
Both IF arms must be source-checked; runtime evaluates exactly one arm. No ownership/current proof may be inferred from a Bool or initial loop value.

Dependency-bearing/unknown-dependency operands, wrong type, foreign source/owner/caller signatures and unsafe effects must remain fail-closed. A bounded dependency-free subset is allowed; never silently erase dependencies.

Runtime results are canonical oracle, not fabricated proof or observed results. Preserve old FIRST/RED. Further negative/OOM instrumentation must be frozen as a new prospective version before running.

01-equality.unknown: quantity formal at definition; let selected Bool; pure binding IF then explicit RETURN
01-equality.oracle: equality true at77, false below/above; exact source order, one helper call per actual, same function instance mapping, no effects

02-less-than.unknown: measurement formal at definition; direct IF predicate with binding-tail u8 return
02-less-than.oracle: strict ordering true below24, false at24 and above; no inferred range precondition or arithmetic

03-known-control.oracle: Canonical legal known Bool/IF CHECK0; existing root-only C17 profile refuses main callable context with exit4. Keep bounded new usize callee capability distinct from generic IF lowering.

04-wrong-operand.oracle: u8 is not usize; reject comparison; no C17 or output replacement

05-wrong-arms.oracle: normal IF arms must agree on one result type; no chosen-convenient-arm acceptance

06-wrong-actual.oracle: actual u8 cannot substitute declared usize formal; no scalar bits/type guessing

07-p1115-loop-control.oracle: immutable P1115 source02 is integration control; predicate progress must not imply H_loop closure or iterative C17. Expect header precision still blocked; preserve old first comparator RED separately.

08-known-bool-control.oracle: existing known equality/Bool/Copy staging without IF; generated C must remain byte-identical after predicate extension

09-wide-equality.oracle: real size_t quantity through formal/Copy alias; distinguish values equal modulo256; same source function, true/false runtime outcomes

10-unsupported-effect.oracle: source legal local scalar Change; pure numeric consumer must not import effects or old/current issuer; refuse C17/no-clobber

11-unsupported-two-arguments.oracle: legal comparison, two formal call ABI outside bounded one-formal consumer; no accidental write-u8 proof substitution

error_no_clobber: All rejecting C17 paths stdout empty; named bytes/inode/mtime unchanged; positive named matches stdout. OOM requires later prospective failure-injection test.
stop: New public issuer, semantic change, forged predicate fact, erased hidden dep, unsafe world/owner mapping, broad abstract Bool/effects architecture or main drift before publication => stop Production and return exact dependency.
calibration: Preserve v1 source/oracle/FIRST. Only v2 separates CHECK and emit expectations for known IF outside current C17 profile; add independent known-Bool C17 control.
